description: This source file defines the PersistableOrderProduct class, which extends OrderProductEntity and implements Serializable. It includes properties for price and attributes related to a product within an order in the e-commerce system.

classes.name: PersistableOrderProduct
classes.description: A class representing a persistable product within an order, including attributes and final price, used in the web entity layer of the sales manager application.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the list of product attributes for this order product.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the list of product attributes associated with this order product.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Returns the final price of the product.

methods.name: setPrice
methods.description: Sets the final price of the product.
